<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/key"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates an API key for the caller, acting in the caller's organization. The response carries the full key in `key`: it is shown only once, so store it then. Use it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. 403 when the caller has no organization. Login tokens only: API keys get 401.
